newsitem.title: UK: OPEC experts begin talks ahead of Vienna meeting.
newsitem.headline: OPEC experts begin talks ahead of Vienna meeting.

text.p: A meeting of OPEC's Economic Commission Board (ECB) of market and technical experts began at the cartel's Vienna headquarters on Monday, OPEC sources said.
The ECB, which draws representatives from all 11 OPEC members, is preparing a supply-demand outlook for the second half of the year ahead of the group's ministerial meeting starting on June 25.

OPEC kingpin Saudi Arabia, the world's biggest oil producer and exporter, is likely to go along with a number of other members who have already said they wanted to keep production quotas unchanged for the second half of 1997.
Last November, OPEC extended its official output ceiling of 25.03 million barrels per day (bpd) to cover the first six months of this year.
Actual output is running closer to 27 million bpd, according to independent estimates.
